protocol.purpose: Descriptive conditional-vs-unconditional risk information; no fitted entry rule or bottom forecast
protocol.price_basis: Unadjusted close for BOTH running-peak state and outcomes; no dividends, costs or FX in this diagnostic
protocol.maturity: Complete endpoints only in final-outcome distributions; incomplete paths reported separately as loss bounds
protocol.episode_definition: First running-peak decline >=5% until first recovery of that preceding peak, inclusive; quiet pre-trigger days outside episodes
protocol.episode_dependence: A long episode can include several economic shocks, and outcomes may cross later episodes. No IID crisis count is claimed.
protocol.seed_policy: Base seed plus zero-based position in fixed symbol order QQQ,QQQM,SMH,SOXX,SPY,VOO,VUG,DRAM; exact offsets saved per symbol
protocol.permutation_policy: Uniform sample without replacement of nonzero circular shifts of ALL bucket labels; same offsets used across horizons within each symbol
protocol.ci_policy: No intervals estimated in this diagnostic. Fewer than10 closed supporting episodes forbids CI;10 is only a necessary screening threshold, not proof of independence or sufficient bootstrap design.
protocol.oos_status: Retrospective exploratory; no untouched out-of-sample claim
protocol.proxy_policy: Own ETF histories only, no splicing; sparse/new funds stay sparse. Existing V3 long-index studies remain separate.
protocol.decision_scope: Does not validate new company growth, valuation, tax, expenses or a3year forward forecast; does not replace the separate V3 executable strategy comparison.

source.history_policy: Own ETF history only; no proxy/index splice
